top_signals.title: Trump administration obligates $307M for military aid to Ukraine
top_signals.summary: The Trump administration has made legally binding commitments to spend almost all of the $400 million Congress approved for military aid to Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump ‘very seriously’ considering diesel export ban as global supply crunch worsens
top_signals.summary: Analysts warn an export ban could backfire, pushing up global diesel prices and potentially triggering higher U.S. gasoline prices as refiners adjust.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UBS Faces 9% Profit Hit From Latest Swiss Capital Plan, RBC Says
top_signals.summary: The latest capital reform proposal adopted by Swiss lawmakers would cut UBS Group AG’s earnings per share by 9%, RBC analysts estimated.
